# The ONU serial number rule, checked on both sides.
#
# One line per vector: the vendor id, the station's own MAC address, and
# the serial number the rule has to produce out of them.  The C side reads
# this file in tests/sk_pon_config.c, and the Rust side reads it in
# overlays/package/libs/libzxpon-omci/omci/src/oam/config.rs.  One file,
# one rule, two implementations, one set of expected bytes.
#
# vendor_id  mac          serial
4f575254    021122334455  4f57525422334455
4f575254    000a1b2c3d4e  4f5752541b2c3d4e
54534554    ffffffffffff  54534554ffffffff
